redactions: Investigation root -> /evidence/issue-1139; user home -> /local-user; credential-shaped values and the configured gateway key are removed if present. No private maintenance chat, auth file, source checkout or hidden model reasoning is included. All native event item types were inspected before staging; the exports contain no reasoning items.
identity_note: Original receipts and prompt hashes bind original local bytes. Published hashes identify the redacted copies; path redaction may change JSON, HTML, receipt and transcript bytes without changing diagram facts. Do not compare a redacted artifact against an original receipt hash.
exclusions: Source-project and Archify package copies, repeated ZIPs, local archives and Python caches are excluded. Reconstruct packages from the recorded public commits; source-project pins and source links remain in the plans/reports. Local toolchain executables are not redistributed; their versions and verification outcomes remain in the logs.
retention: Keep the evidence branch and immutable commit reachable through review and the resulting release cycle. This is evidence retention, not an authenticity proof.
